opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000, plus a £1000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24 resident in the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy or regenerative agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day fully funded study tour for young people aged 18-24, linking successful applicants directly to farmers through the Nuffield Scholar network. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. The 2027 round plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
